# ChatView Sidebar Expansion

## Problem
The sidebar in ChatView.vue doesn't expand when clicking on any area - only on specific buttons.

## Solution
1. Add click handler to entire ChatSidebar container
2. Implement logic to expand sidebar on any click when in compact mode
3. Preserve existing toggle button functionality

## Files to Modify
- `src/views/ChatView.vue` - ChatSidebar interaction

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ Clicking anywhere in sidebar expands it
- ✅ Toggle button still works
- ✅ No double-toggle issues
- ✅ Mobile behavior unaffected
